capabilities: Render titles as ASCII art from ascii-art code blocks
Select from a list of FIGlet fonts
Align and colour output with hex codes or theme presets
Configure default font, size, colour, full width and scrolling
extras: The manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian headings are plain text, so there is no built-in way to display them as decorative ASCII art inside notes.
summary: Code-block renderer that turns headings into ASCII art using FIGlet fonts, with font, alignment and colour options.
